name: cookie_settings
title: Cookie Settings Button
summary: Button that reopens the cookie notice settings.
description: Button that reopens the cookie notice with its settings panel (cookie_notice.js handles [data-cookie-settings]). Default: a subtle icon-only gear in the text size (used in the footer by website_info); with "text" and "class" it becomes a normal button, and "status" adds a live line with the current analytics choice. Renders nothing when the cookie notice is turned off.
